name: el.cine
text:
AI ending interior design

Nano banana 2 now can turn sketch floor plan into 4K 3D rendering with accurate dimension, take photos for each room, and 1-click furniture change

used to cost $100k and months.. now cents and mins

step by step tutorial on OpenArt:
gist: Nano Banana 2 能把手绘户型图变成 4K 3D 渲染，还能一键换家具；附 OpenArt 教程。
title: Nano Banana 2：手绘户型图 → 4K 3D 室内渲染
summary: 图像模型应用教程：在 OpenArt 里用 Nano Banana 2，把手绘户型图转成尺寸准确的 4K 3D 渲染；再在图上标出房间和相机角度，生成各房间的写实照片；还能一键换家具。thread 里给出分步操作和 prompt。和 agent 主题无关，属于 AI 应用案例。
